entries.title: Set up Infinitary started by a command from another computer
entries.body: When a command starts Infinitary with no window, the computer that controls it now shows its Settings: General, Projects, Intelligence, Usage and Integrations. Connect its subscriptions there, choose its projects folder by its path, and use a card's Open settings button. A sign-in page opens in the browser of the computer you are using.

picture.alt: Connect a subscription to begin, over a line saying a command started your first mate on Mac mini so it signs in from here, and the subscription chips.
